integrity.proof_method: deterministic zero-forcing closure plus all-source BFS

scientific_limitations: Exact claim concerns only the 20-vertex Desargues graph. Complete all-pairs distances are proved by a standalone exhaustive integer checker; a second independent construction verifies states, edges and selected BFS roots. The base zero-forcing number and general reconfiguration framework are prior literature, and unindexed equivalent computations remain possible.
title: Almost-Johnson geodesics in Desargues zero-forcing reconfiguration
